title: Rulemaking authority.
bodyText: The department shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 as necessary to carry out the purposes of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §801G-13  Rulemaking authority.  The department shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 as necessary to carry out the purposes of this chapter. [L 2018, c 115, pt of §1; am L 2019, c 274, §5; am L 2023, c 82, §5]
